user_input: Using D:\hr\hr-app-build-spec-v2.md as the authoritative source, rearchitect and implement the existing HR app end-to-end in D:\hr. The current one-file JSX/localStorage prototype must be replaced incrementally with the spec-required local-first architecture and functional modules. Do not merely report a plan: execute the highest-value implementation batch now, preserving working behavior while creating the foundation for all modules. Start with TypeScript/Vite architecture, IndexedDB-backed API/service layer, routing, auth/setup/sample workspace, shared UI/control contract, and core workflows (people, leave, attendance, timesheets, hiring/onboarding). Then continue with remaining modules as far as feasible. Validate after each coherent batch with lint/build/tests and document any remaining gaps honestly. Keep all visible controls functional; remove unfinished modules from navigation rather than leaving placeholders. Use the spec's sections and acceptance criteria as traceability. Classification: brownfield rewrite. Feasibility: likely feasible but broad; record any uncertainty. Project facts: 480 LOC JavaScript/JSX, Vite React prototype, git repository, frontend-only localStorage prototype.
title: HR prototype to local-first TypeScript/Vite application

assessment_snapshot.intro: The repository is a small Vite React frontend-only prototype that currently uses one-file JSX and localStorage, while the authoritative build specification requires an incremental local-first rewrite.

The specification is broad; feasibility is likely, but module parity and any undocumented behavior remain uncertain

proposed_outcome: Replace the prototype incrementally in place with a TypeScript/Vite React local-first application backed by an IndexedDB API/service layer, preserving working behavior and implementing only functional, validated modules in navigation. Use the authoritative build specification and acceptance criteria for traceability, keep controls usable, and record gaps or uncertain behavior rather than presenting placeholders.
